edges.reason: msg.sender is written into storage initialization of the owner variable.
Owned constructor stores the deploying caller as owner.
acceptOwnership authorizes the caller with require(msg.sender == newOwner).
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before allowing execution.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner authorization check.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the owner state variable through onlyOwner.
msg.sender selects the balance mapping slot debited by transfer.
msg.sender selects the allowance mapping slot written by approve.
msg.sender selects the spender allowance slot consumed by transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner and is forwarded to the external callback.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
recipient parameter flows into the balances credit inside transfer.
amount parameter flows into the arithmetic inside transfer.
safeSub performs an unsigned subtraction that only relies on require(b <= a).
safeAdd performs an unsigned addition guarded by require(c >= a).
safeMul performs an unsigned multiplication guarded by a division check.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for the token and allowance debits.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping for msg.sender.
from parameter selects the balance slot debited by transferFrom.
to parameter selects the balance slot credited by transferFrom.
tokens parameter flows into the arithmetic inside transferFrom.
approve writes the allowed mapping without an overwrite guard.
spender parameter selects the allowance slot written by approve.
tokens parameter is stored as the new allowance by approve.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter selects the outer allowance mapping key.
spender parameter selects the inner allowance mapping key.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter selects the balance mapping key.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] when computing the circulating supply.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into a caller-supplied spender address.
The invoked spender contract can re-enter approveAndCall or other token functions during the callback.
spender parameter controls the address of the external call target.
tokens parameter is both stored as allowance and forwarded to the callback.
data parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract, restricted by onlyOwner.
tokenAddress parameter controls the external call target.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external token transfer.
constructor assigns the token symbol.
constructor assigns the token name.
constructor assigns the decimals value.
constructor assigns the total supply.
constructor mints the entire supply into the deployer address balance.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership updates the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads and then clears the newOwner state variable.
